[b]Infiltration: Alone in Combat[/b]

[previewyoutube=IsXBVGIbbqw;full][/previewyoutube]

A Third Person Shooter Game where you have to infiltrate the enemy lines and complete the mission.

You will need to infiltrate the enemy lines and complete the assigned mission in order to undermine their plans.
This is a game where aim and caution are key to accomplishing missions. Any wrong move can bring the end. It is you against the entire enemy army.
